items.evidence: Company performance assessed at 75%, reflecting lower profits and higher expenses
Individual performance and risk management performance are also evaluated through a robust performance management program
Risk Management Reflects progress each named executive made against risk management specific to their roles and business/function
As a precondition to our named executives earning 2019 annual incentives, one of the following goals must have been met: (1) EPS of at least $3.00
The number of Performance Shares earned at the end of the performance period depends on the achievement of average three-year ROTCE
In order for an award to pay above 125% of target, our relative Total Shareholder Return (TSR) for the performance period must be in the top quartile
For any year in the three-year performance period that our Company incurs a Net Operating Loss (NOL), the target number of Performance Shares will be reduced by one-third.
Reduction for failure to make progress on regulatory matters
